name: Kanzaki Toru
source:
Kento's childhood friend and a member of X.I.P. Having previously joined his school's choir, Toru has a talent for singing.

Despite being the shortest of the six idols, Toru is surprisingly candid about his opinions and acts apathetic around others. He also has a habit of casually dismissing people as idiots.

[from [url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Tokimeki_Restaurant%E2%98%86%E2%98%86%E2%98%86]Koei Wikia[/url]]
